map.匹兹堡睡眠质量指数(PSQI)简化版，评估过去1个月的睡眠质量，7个维度各0-3: A simplified Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI) assessing sleep quality over the past month, 0-3 points for each of 7 dimensions, 0-21 total, where a higher score means worse sleep quality.
map.本工具是匹兹堡睡眠质量指数（PSQI）的简化版，用 7 个维度评估「过去 1 个: This tool is a simplified version of the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI) that evaluates sleep over the "past 1 month" across 7 dimensions: subjective quality, sleep latency, actual sleep, sleep efficiency, sleep disturbance, hypnotic medication and daytime function. Each dimension scores 0-3 for a total of 0-21, and a higher score means worse sleep quality (5 or more suggests a sleep deviation). Everything runs in the browser and no answer is uploaded.
map.总分0-5睡眠质量良好 6-10睡眠质量一般 11-15睡眠质量较差 16-21: Total 0-5 good sleep quality, 6-10 average, 11-15 fairly poor, 16-21 very poor
map.点选项文字即可作答，也可用键盘 1–4 / ← →: Click the option text to answer; you can also use keys 1-4 / ← →
map.题号速览（点任意题号可回去改答案）: Question number overview (click any number to go back and change that answer)
map.请按「过去 1 个月」的真实睡眠情况作答，不是某一天或一辈子的状态: Please answer based on your real sleep over the "past 1 month", not a single day or your whole life
map.7 个维度各 0–3 分，合计 0–21 分；分数越高代表睡眠质量越差: The 7 dimensions score 0-3 each, 0-21 in total; a higher score means worse sleep quality
map.本评估为自评参考，≥5 分提示睡眠偏差，但不构成医学诊断: This is a self-rating reference; 5 or more suggests a sleep deviation, but it is not a medical diagnosis
map.答题进度仅保存在本机浏览器，点「重新测试」即可清空，数据不会上传: Your progress is stored only in this local browser. Click "Restart test" to clear it; no data is uploaded
map.PSQI评估的是过去1个月的睡眠状况: PSQI assesses sleep over the past month
map.总分>7分通常被认为是睡眠质量差的分界线: A total above 7 points is usually treated as the boundary for poor sleep quality
map.催眠药物使用维度>0分需关注药物依赖风险: A hypnotic medication score above 0 calls for attention to the risk of dependence
map.该量表仅供参考，不替代睡眠医学专业诊断: This scale is for reference only and does not replace a professional sleep medicine diagnosis
map.📚 深度解析：睡眠质量评分（PSQI简化版）: 📚 Deep dive: Sleep Quality Rating (Simplified PSQI)
map.日常睡眠自查：不需要填完整版 19 题，用 7 个关键维度快速判断睡眠质量大概处: Everyday sleep self-check: instead of filling in the full 19 items, use these 7 key dimensions to get a quick idea of roughly where your sleep quality sits.
map.助眠方法评估：尝试运动、冥想或调整作息后，隔周测一次看总分是否下降。: Evaluating sleep aids: after trying exercise, meditation or a schedule change, measure every other week and see whether the total drops.
map.轮班 / 倒时差人群：作息不规律时用来监控睡眠是否长期偏离正常。: Shift workers and jet-lagged travelers: use it to monitor whether sleep has been drifting away from normal over the long term when your schedule is irregular.
map.本题覆盖主观质量、入睡时长、睡眠时长、效率、干扰、助眠药、白天功能，每维 0~3: This test covers subjective quality, sleep latency, sleep duration, efficiency, disturbance, sleep medication and daytime function, 0-3 points each for 0-21 total. The closer to 0 the better; 5 or more suggests poor sleep quality and it is worth running the full PSQI.
map.简化版和完整 PSQI 差在哪？: How does the simplified version differ from the full PSQI?
map.完整版（psqi-assessment）有 19 题、7 个成分分；本简化版直接: The full version (psqi-assessment) has 19 items and 7 component scores; this simplified version asks about the 7 dimensions directly, which is faster but less detailed, so it suits everyday tracking.
map.多少分该去看医生？: At what score should I see a doctor?
map.总分≥5 通常提示睡眠质量偏差；若同时有白天严重嗜睡、情绪受影响，建议到睡眠门诊: A total of 5 or more usually suggests a deviation in sleep quality; if it comes with severe daytime sleepiness or mood impact, consider a sleep clinic or psychiatry visit.
map.PSQI(匹兹堡睡眠质量指数)是评估睡眠质量的国际标准量表，从主观睡眠质量、入睡: PSQI (Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index) is the international standard scale for assessing sleep quality. It evaluates 7 dimensions — subjective sleep quality, sleep latency, sleep duration, sleep efficiency, sleep disturbance, hypnotic medication and daytime function — for a total of 0-21 points.
